craft_notes: Sthāyin: eighty-one devoured. Rows: remember, devour, result. Rejected: smoothing ending — killed: flagged obscure. Read aloud: counted burn.

lines: Hence very eighty-one, when word-remembering, through manifold in-going —
that one, the Highest-aimed notion, by time-devoured,
l4.sanskrit_cite: ata eva ekāśīti padasmaraṇasamaye vividhadharmānupraveśamukhena eka eva asau parameśvaraviṣayo vikalpaḥ kālagrāse na avikalpātmā eva sampadyate iti
